# The source frontend is an internal, checked mode with no object output.
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

! go tool compile -logos.cgoeject -logos.eject=$WORK/plain-out plain/main.go
stdout 'logos.cgoeject requires original loGo/s cgo sources'
! exists $WORK/plain-out

! go tool compile -logos.cgoeject -logos.eject=$WORK/lgo-out lgo/main.lgo
stdout 'logos.cgoeject requires original loGo/s cgo sources'
! exists $WORK/lgo-out

! go tool compile -logos.cgoeject -logos.eject=$WORK/missing-out cgo/main.lgo
stdout 'main.lgo:4:.*undefined: C.int'
! exists $WORK/missing-out

! go tool compile -logos.cgoeject -logos.eject=$WORK/wrong-out cgo/wrong.lgo cgo/_cgo_gotypes.go
stdout 'wrong.lgo:4:.*cannot use "bad"'
! exists $WORK/wrong-out

go tool compile -p p -o source.o -logos.cgoeject -logos.eject=$WORK/valid-out cgo/main.lgo cgo/_cgo_gotypes.go
exists $WORK/valid-out/main.go
grep 'var X C.int = 1' $WORK/valid-out/main.go
! exists source.o

-- plain/main.go --
package p

-- lgo/main.lgo --
package p

-- cgo/main.lgo --
package p
import "C"

var X C.int = 1

-- cgo/wrong.lgo --
package p
import "C"

var X C.int = "bad"

-- cgo/_cgo_gotypes.go --
package p

type _Ctype_int int32
